verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs extensively document its public Checkout/Payments/Platforms APIs, including endpoints, idempotency keys, webhooks, refusal reasons, and testing tools, giving a clear documented public API surface an AI-native user could drive programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard paths) and independent hands-on developer corroboration of API usability beyond vendor docs.
